what: Mistake: on 13 Nov ~22:03 UTC I told Sri the planner-escalation job landed and was fine, without reading the drain lines after it. The running (older) Athena refused athena.toml's new planner_revision_* keys; readings failed for ~5 min until my routine drain-restart at 22:07. An independent review found it.
why: I reported the landing from the monitor's 'landed' line and the verifier summary only; I did not check the drain log for errors right after a config-changing landing.
